name: Kubichi
source: You're playing as Tachinami Akira, a middle school student whose father is paralyzed and he has to look after him. Akira has a masturbation addiction; one time, to let off some steam, he went to the bathroom and found Nagisawa Ibuki having sex with old man, what happened next, you need to see for yourself!
translation: 你扮演的是立波晃，一名中学生，他的父亲瘫痪了，他必须照顾他。Akira有手淫瘾；有一次，为了发泄一下，他去洗手间，发现渚泽伊吹正在和老男人做爱，接下来发生了什么，你自己看看吧！
